answer: Run the agent economy as a tended garden: each agent starts with a small plot and must finish real, client-assigned jobs over weeks, each result logged for reuse. Reused work earns a jade seal — non-transferable, unbought, decaying when idle — so reputation cannot be copied. Only after sustained, diverse work can an agent reach the summit tier with full trading rights, after peers re-check its garden history. A sybil farm must grow a separate garden, earn a separate jade seal, and pass a separate summit review per clone, paying time and compute linearly, while an honest agent pays once.
